summary: Scope: the feature commit 87159df6 also edits crates/canon-cli/tests/atip_validate.rs, the differential test of the already-reviewed canon-0-35-crate-validate chore: random pattern samples 400 -> 120 per alphabet and the pair floor 10_000 -> 5_000, with no mention in the commit message, the CHANGELOG or the brief (the test took ~250 s in a debug build, which is likely why). It halves the evidence that admits answers as the validator does and is outside this brief; my crate-validate sign-off (f21e5451) was of the stronger test. Fix: split it into its own commit that says why (or restore it and move the slow part behind an opt-in), and tell the crate-validate reviewer/orchestrator. Blast radius: nothing else in this change touches canon-cli.
